title: big obelisks
description: this mod adds towering obelisks in your world
body:
this mod adds gaint obelisks in your world which goes up to 400 blocks in y level.

i made this mod mainly for distant horizon and voxy (use voxy port cuz this mod aint out in fabric yet) for the stunning view it can give.

this can take alot of time to load if you dont have a mid pc so keep that in mind.

you can use this mod with other worldgen mod and structures mod for even more of a stunning view.
